description: exp17's sum-scaled log-sum-exp actor paired with an anchor-pair LUT critic carrying the SAME exponential readout, each with its own trainable tau. Tests whether an exponential value head gives the actor's tau a reason to use the max-like regime.
critic: anchor-pair LUT, tables_per_head=32 (matches the actor and exp13)
readout: T * tau * log((1/T) * sum_t exp(w_t / tau))
